scope: Frozen verified release bundles, prepared delivery intents, trusted approval records, and post-approval change rejection

red_evidence.reason: the release bundle, delivery intent, and controlled approval modules were absent

assertions: bundle hash binds title, summary, body, ordered assets, content revision, detection review, and target account
working packages cannot create verified delivery intents
a prepared intent has no remote write authorization
model self-approval and untrusted interaction channels are rejected
approval binds actor, intent, bundle hash, target account, and approval time
body, asset, or target-account replacement after approval blocks delivery

review.kind: separate primary-agent review because delegated review is disabled by session policy

live_blocker: No trusted live delivery interaction or remote target account was used, so remote approval and write admission remain unverified.
